Depict ONLY ADRIAN BELLWEATHER, the same nineteen-year-old male identity in every view: warm medium-brown skin, short uneven dark hair, lean young-adult build, expressive thoughtful face with a restrained wry quality. Show a clear full-length front view in a plain charcoal formal coat, a three-quarter upper-body view in that same coat, a clean profile head view, and one upper-body morning-shirt view of the SAME identity in a plain light shirt. Keep the same face, hair, skin tone and proportions across all four views. Formal clothing is simple fantasy household attire, unadorned, no armor or invented heraldry. Hands are relaxed and anatomically readable. This is a reference sheet, not a story scene. Drawing language: crisp bold black contours, heavier outer silhouettes, confident expressive comic anatomy, broad saturated flat color fills and hard-edged shadows with limited tonal steps. Use clean graphic shapes and clear color/value separation; preserve warm natural skin rather than tinting it blue. No watercolor, washes, dense hatching, aged paper, soft painted modeling, photorealism, gradients or glossy 3D. Place the exact heading ADRIAN BELLWEATHER at the top, large uppercase comic lettering, black ink, entirely visible. No other text. Keep generous white separation among views, no overlap, no clipped feet or heads. No other character, weapons, jewelry, spell effects, visible magical threads, cords, glowing eyes, book, props, background setting or watermark.
